thread:
alex: Quick sync — proposed PRD for invoke contracts (structured output + function calling validation). sharing high-level asks and launch criteria.

sam: dropping my quick notes. we need deterministic failure modes + clear error responses for invalid schema.

maria: +1. Also need KV-cache implications for function args size; large payloads might hit token limits.

jordan: UX note — clients expect clear code for partial success: status + results[] + errors[].

alex: propose priority: 1) validation + stable error schema 2) fallback policies (model variant / stub) 3) perf SLOs. Thoughts?

sam: agree. add acceptance criteria: - schema validation runs in <10ms median - errors are machine-readable (error.code, path, message) - no silent truncation

lisa: from support: top customer asks are: better typing for tool args, retryability semantics, and test harness.

maria: edge cases: nested unions, unknown enum values, circular refs in schema. propose rejecting circular refs with 400 + 'validation.incompatible_schema'

alex: draft validation error example:
```
{ "error": { "code": "validation.invalid_field", "path": ["tools","email","to"], "message": "expected string, got object" } }
```

sam: fallback policy options: a) auto-fallback to compatible model variant b) call a stub/responder plugin c) reject with 429/503. recommend (a) with telemetry + opt-out.

jordan: acceptance criteria for fallback: measurable latency delta <= 2x, fallback only when model variant compatible, audit trail in console.

alex: rollout plan: canary 5% for internal customers -> 25% with opt-in SDK flag -> GA. Launch criteria: data retention for errors, test harness, docs + quickstart.

maria: test harness checklist: unit validation, fuzzy invalid inputs, schema contract tests, golden outputs for tool calls.

lisa: prioritize customers: endpoint for finance client (PII) wants strict validation + private deploy compatibility.

sam: scope negotiation: do we build generic JSON-schema-compatible validator or a lightweight Redwood contract language? tradeoffs?

alex: leaning contract lang (smaller footprint, better error codes). but need migration tool from JSON Schema.

jordan: doc tasks: add example snippets for SDKs, show how to opt-out, and error mapping table.

dev_bot: deploy queued: docs branch -> review

alex: OK — I'll update PRD with these ACs and a triage matrix. anyone want to take RFC draft?

sam: I'll take RFC draft (will share a PR by EOD tomorrow).

maria: I'll write validation test harness prototypes this week.

lisa: I'll draft customer-facing FAQ and sample error handling snippets.

alex: thanks all. ping me if you want demo data for the case studies. :thumbsup:
